player.relation: (() => { if (player.self) return 0; const relation = self.relation(player); const proximity = player.knows('distance') ? (player.distance <= neighboring ? 8 : player.distance <= nearby ? 4 : player.distance > regional ? -8 : 0) : 0; const ties = (relation.get('war') ? 10 : 0) + (relation.friend || relation.pact ? 6 : 0) + (relation.get('denouncedThem') || relation.get('denouncedByThem') ? 6 : 0) + (relation.vassalOf || relation.masterOf ? 8 : 0); const cityState = player.get('cityState') ? (player.is.alliedCityState ? 4 : -6) : 0; return Math.max(-15, Math.min(20, proximity + ties + cityState)) + player.stake.intel; })()
player.intel: (() => { if (player.self) return 0; const points = player.get('ourDiplomatPoints') ?? 0; const diplomat = player.get('ourDiplomatThere') ? (points >= 800 ? 10 : points >= 200 ? 6 : 3) : 0; return Math.min(15, diplomat + player.stake.spy); })()
player.front: (() => { if (player.self) return 0; const relation = self.relation(player); if (!relation.get('war')) return 0; const proximity = player.get('cityState') ? -12 : player.knows('distance') ? (player.distance <= nearby ? 10 : player.distance > regional ? -10 : 0) : 0; const score = Math.abs(relation.get('warScore') ?? 0); return proximity + (score >= 50 ? 8 : score >= 25 ? 4 : 0) + (relation.get('warWeariness') >= 50 ? 6 : 0) + player.stake.spy; })()
player.war: (() => { if (!player.self || !player.get('wars')?.length) return 0; const fronts = player.wars.filter(opponent => opponent.get('major')); if (!fronts.length) return player.wars.every(opponent => opponent.get('cityState')) ? -10 : 0; return Math.max(-10, Math.min(20, fronts.reduce((total, opponent) => total + opponent.stake.front, 0) + 4 * (fronts.length - 1))); })()
